evals: +0.124 AUROC · 5 of 5 folds higher | On the held-out curated Pharos gene-disease pairs, a graph neural network that also counts the paths between a gene and a disease (GNN + paths) scores higher on the enriched graph that is shipped than on Pharos alone: +0.124 AUROC (95% CI +0.117 to +0.130, 5 of 5 folds higher).

The predicted links on the cards come from the meta-path model: +0.113 AUROC over Pharos alone (95% CI +0.106 to +0.120, 5 of 5 folds higher). | buttons before steps: true | A graph of 1,324,141 nodes and 29,680,679 links built from Pharos, the Drug Target Ontology, Open Targets, ChEMBL and the HPO/GO/MONDO hierarchies, with a keep-or-prune verdict on every link across all layers (29,290,179 kept, 390,500 pruned; of the 26,462,802 Pharos links, 256,639 pruned). The model proposes 112,187 gene-disease links that no source in the graph states yet (of 277,490 scored predictions: 154,384 restate a pair the graph already holds, 154,114 of them only as a text-mining co-mention, and 10,919 name a broader category of a disease already linked to the gene). Plus a trial layer of failed drug programs: 3,220 nodes, 5,220 links, every claim traced to its source record. | safari note open: false
